remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. There is a mountain in the background and several small bumps, representing straw piles, in the foreground. This image dominates the top half of the paper, the bottom half of the paper contains O'Keeffe's writing about the colors of the scene.
title: Untitled (Landscape)
